title: Block dha on the local-host stop causes that made ncv supervised: 4sb, aqm, b50, 80x, ox0, 6na, v3q
body: Of ncv's 17 stops, 8 were untriaged-findings holds (aqm, which depends on 4sb), 3 were review re-dispatches on identical source (80x), 1 was a premature 'CI absent' refusal (ox0) and 1 was a rerere-poisoned merge (6na). The NOT READY review was recorded as ready-to-merge (b50). None of these is parented to or blocking dha, so dha's own gate run would stop for the same reasons. v3q also carries ncv's unmet criterion that the tracker client passes the 3.2 fixtures. cxk's 'PR carries the review' requires 4sb.
